title: Shanghai printing support and Sephardic Jewish education — 5706
summary_researcher: A documented correspondence chain links requests for printing resources in Shanghai with continued educational work among the local Sephardic community. Letter רלט explicitly points back to earlier items on both matters; its concluding teaching is editorially linked to letter רמ, where the practical concern is developed into a broader argument for attending to refugees' spiritual needs and engaging Jews who are not yet observant.

linked_candidates.basis: publisher cross-reference from רלט to earlier printing-funds matter
publisher cross-reference from רלט to earlier Sephardic educational project

dedup_rule: Letters רלט and רמ are distinct item witnesses but belong to one documentary chain; they must not be presented as independent corroboration merely because the teaching appears across adjacent publications. Earlier cross-referenced letters are linkage candidates until item identity/status is checked.
synthesis_rule: A future answer may synthesize practical and educational themes across verified members, but must distinguish direct requests, editorial cross-references and researcher-level thematic synthesis.

provenance.basis: direct authorized Kehot/Chabad.org item witnesses and explicit publisher cross-references
provenance.verification_scope: family linkage only; no missing incoming correspondence reconstructed
